About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced IT System Administrator to ensure the stable, secure, and efficient operation of our global IT environment. You will manage infrastructure, cloud services, endpoints, and security solutions while supporting modern workplace technologies and ensuring compliance with corporate and regulatory requirements.
 Your Responsibilities 
Administer Windows server, client, and cloud environments
Manage Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and endpoint services
Support network, VPN, and security infrastructure
Monitor systems, backups, and disaster recovery processes
Ensure compliance with IT security standards and governance requirements
Provide 2nd-level support and collaborate with internal teams and external partners
Support the rollout and administration of Microsoft Copilot and AI services 
 Your Profile 
Experience in IT infrastructure and system administration
Strong knowledge of Microsoft technologies, networking, and endpoint management
Understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, and IT operations
Structured and solution-oriented working style
Strong communication and teamwork skills
Familiarity with ITIL processes is an advantage
 What We Offer 
A modern international IT environment
Opportunities to work with cloud, AI, and security technologies
Professional development and certification opportunities
Flexible working arrangements
A collaborative and innovative team culture
 Interested? 
 Join us and help shape a secure, modern, and future-ready IT landscape. Apply now with your CV and salary expectations.
